# pre-commit-checklists

> Curated selections of public pre-commit hooks, packaged into checklists and
> exposed as consumer-selectable hook ids: file hygiene, spelling, structured
> file linting, per-language checks, secrets scanning, and git
> branch/commit-message guards.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti/pre-commit-checklists

## What it does

pre-commit-checklists groups curated `pre-commit` hooks into checklist files
under `checklists/`, then exposes each checklist as one hook id in
`.pre-commit-hooks.yaml`. A consumer repository adds a single `repo:` entry
pinned to a release tag and lists the hook ids it wants, instead of
hand-assembling and maintaining a long list of individual hook entries
itself. `scripts/install.sh` bootstraps a target repository from a template
in one command; `templates/pre-commit-config/` ships ready-to-copy configs
for common cases and a handful of languages.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): Pitch, quickstart, and the full hook catalogue
- [.pre-commit-hooks.yaml](.pre-commit-hooks.yaml): Every hook id this library exposes
- [checklists/](checklists/): The curated hook lists, one YAML file per checklist
- [templates/pre-commit-config/](templates/pre-commit-config/): Ready-to-copy consumer configs
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh): Bootstraps a target repository from a template
- [docs/hook-catalogue.md](docs/hook-catalogue.md): What each hook id runs and matches
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): Full setup walkthrough
- [docs/versioning.md](docs/versioning.md): What the `rev:` pin means and how it moves
- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): Machine-readable citation metadata

## Tech stack

- pre-commit
- Bash, for the dispatcher and validation scripts under `scripts/`
- detect-secrets, for the credentials checklist
- GNU Make
